audit.why: EVEN at 6/10 is consistent with the level chart: Pantheon owns level 1, Akali owns 3-5 and both item stages, Pantheon takes 6 back as a roam window. Early lane favours Pantheon, side lane and teamfights favour Akali.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes call Akali's ultimate 'her R' and never give a cooldown, so the level-6 warning has nothing behind it.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s and is a leap plus a recast dash that executes. Naming it and its 120s rank-1 cooldown turns the warning into a timer the player can actually track.
audit.corrected: Level-6 spike now names Perfect Execution and its 120s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was stated only loosely ('drop your W target lock'), and wants.you[1] claimed blocking her Shuriken Flip with Aegis Assault makes 'the dash whiff' — that is a damage block, not a mark block, and I cannot verify it stops the recast.
audit.why: Riot's Twilight Shroud text: inside it Akali is invisible and 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'. Shield Vault is a targeted dash, so it simply cannot be cast on her in the smoke — that is the real mechanic. Riot's Shuriken Flip text also says the first enemy OR SMOKE CLOUD hit is marked, so she can mark her own shroud and dash back to it.
audit.corrected: Shield Vault cannot select Akali inside Twilight Shroud; Shuriken Flip can mark the smoke itself and dash back to it. Aegis Assault blocks her damage from the front — the block claim is stated as a damage block only.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere for the two abilities the lane is played around.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud 20/19/18/17/16s and Perfect Execution 120/90/60s are the two windows. Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Shroud's 20s and Perfect Execution's 120s now appear in the cooldown-facing text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Several strings refer to Akali as 'him'/'his', and dontsFull[1] ('Fight her 6 with no MR') has a body about burning a cooldown.
audit.why: Wrong pronoun and title/body mismatch both read as unedited boilerplate.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and the don't body rewritten to Perfect Execution's execute.

edits.before: Use Twilight Shroud to drop your W target lock and your turret aggro, then E-dash out of your all-in
edits.after: Drop Twilight Shroud to break Shield Vault's target lock and turret aggro, then Shuriken Flip away

edits.before: Hard-shove and all-in with W-stun into empowered Q at levels 1-3 before she has Shroud charges and E to escape
edits.after: Hard-shove and all-in with Shield Vault into empowered Comet Spear at 1-3, before Twilight Shroud and Shuriken Flip

edits.before: Bait her E shuriken into your Aegis Assault block so the dash whiffs, then W-stun and empower-Q burst
edits.after: Face her Shuriken Flip so Aegis Assault eats it from the front, then Shield Vault and empowered-Q burst

edits.before: With Q, W and Aegis Assault online you have a premier kill window — E-block her shuriken, W-stun, empowered Q, and she dies before Twilight Shroud comes back up.
edits.after: With Q, W and Aegis Assault online you have a premier kill window — face Shuriken Flip, Shield Vault, empowered Q, and she dies inside Twilight Shroud's 20 seconds.

edits.before: Her R two-part dash plus execute is her first real kill threat on you — stay topped up and respect the all-in once she hits 6.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's leap and executing recast are her first real kill threat — 120s at rank 1, so respect every all-in once she is 6.

edits.before: Her R two-part dash and execute give her the first real all-in on you — she edges the duel once she's 6.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's leap and executing recast give her the first real all-in — she edges the duel from 6.

edits.before: Through 4-5 you're still favoured — held-Q pokes her off the wave and your E block neuters her shuriken poke — but her energy and Shroud let her stabilize, so kill pressure dips to a coinflip if she plays it clean. The real shift is 6: her R two-part dash and execute finally give her a way to all-in you, and if you're chunked she can flip a trade. Don't dive a Shroud blindly — she'll vanish the W target lock and your turret aggro. Trade on YOUR terms: bait the E, block it, then commit.
edits.after: Through 4-5 you're still favoured — held Comet Spear pokes her off the wave and Aegis Assault eats Five Point Strike from the front — but energy and Twilight Shroud let her stabilize, so kill pressure dips if she plays clean. The shift is 6: Perfect Execution's leap and executing recast finally give her an all-in. Never dive the smoke — inside it she cannot be selected by Shield Vault or your turret, and Shuriken Flip marks the cloud itself to dash back in.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Twilight Shroud: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Twilight Shroud's 20s: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve her.

edits.before: Best wave: held near your side so Akali overextends into your pattern. Worst wave: shoved to his tower with your key cooldowns down. Crash timing: crash only to reset, take plates, or set up a dive — never on autopilot.
edits.after: Best wave: held near your side so Akali overextends into your pattern. Worst wave: shoved to her tower with your key cooldowns down. Crash timing: crash only to reset, take plates, or set up a dive — never on autopilot.

edits.before: If Akali gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Twilight Shroud. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If he snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.
edits.after: If Akali gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Twilight Shroud. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If she snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.

edits.before: Untargetable inside it. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 20s at rank 1 — unselectable inside it. Engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Shield Vault cannot select her in there — refuse it and half her win condition goes.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Perfect Execution executes on the recast — MR and HP beat it.

edits.before: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside it. Fight when down. When it is down — W-Q burst her.
edits.after: Track Twilight Shroud (20s): Shield Vault cannot select her inside it. When down — W-Q burst her.
